source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official bottle selection, format, checksum and relocation contract.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: When a formula defines a bottle matching the system, Homebrew downloads and installs it automatically. Bottles are gzipped tarballs; sha256 identifies the platform bottle. A cellar value of :any or :any_skip_relocation means safe relocation, while other bottles depend on the matching Homebrew cellar.
